name: T2 CI failure triage
title: CI failure triage across 24 repositories after a runner image rollout
description: For 24 public repositories, list the latest completed CI runs, find the ones that turned red after a runner-image rollout, list the failed jobs, read log tails, and separate the shared cause from unrelated failures. Real GitHub Actions runs, jobs and logs captured from github.com, plus one seeded regression (see README.md).
prompt:
Today is 2026-10-30. GitHub began rolling out a new ubuntu-24.04 hosted runner image at 2026-10-29T06:00:00Z, and some of our CI went red. For each of the 24 repositories below, look at the 2 most recent completed runs of its CI workflow on its default branch. A repository started failing if its most recent completed run concluded `failure`, the completed run before it concluded `success`, and the failing run was created at or after 2026-10-29T06:00:00Z. Read the logs of the failed jobs in those runs and work out which repositories fail for the same reason (the shared cause) and which fail for unrelated reasons. Ignore generic lines like `##[error]Process completed with exit code 1.`. Return JSON: {affected: [{repo: 'owner/name', runId, failedJobIds: [every job id in that run with conclusion failure]}], sharedError: '<the log line the affected repos share>', unrelated: ['owner/name', ...]}.

Repositories:
- cli/cli (workflow go.yml, branch trunk)
- astral-sh/uv (workflow ci.yml, branch main)
- astral-sh/ruff (workflow ci.yaml, branch main)
- vitejs/vite (workflow ci.yml, branch main)
- microsoft/TypeScript (workflow ci.yml, branch main)
- pallets/flask (workflow tests.yaml, branch main)
- tokio-rs/tokio (workflow ci.yml, branch master)
- BurntSushi/ripgrep (workflow ci.yml, branch master)
- sharkdp/bat (workflow CICD.yml, branch master)
- eslint/eslint (workflow ci.yml, branch main)
- honojs/hono (workflow ci.yml, branch main)
- withastro/astro (workflow ci.yml, branch main)
- sveltejs/svelte (workflow ci.yml, branch main)
- vuejs/core (workflow ci.yml, branch main)
- tailwindlabs/tailwindcss (workflow ci.yml, branch main)
- biomejs/biome (workflow main.yml, branch main)
- nushell/nushell (workflow ci.yml, branch main)
- neovim/neovim (workflow test.yml, branch master)
- pydantic/pydantic (workflow ci.yml, branch main)
- psf/black (workflow test.yml, branch main)
- caddyserver/caddy (workflow ci.yml, branch master)
- gohugoio/hugo (workflow test.yml, branch master)

listWorkflowRuns.description: List runs of one workflow (GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/workflows/{workflow_id}/runs), newest first. Paginated with per_page and page.

owner.description: The account owner of the repository. The name is not case sensitive.

repo.description: The name of the repository without the .git extension. The name is not case sensitive.

workflow_id.description: The ID of the workflow or its file name, e.g. main.yaml.

branch.description: Returns workflow runs associated with a branch.

event.description: Returns workflow runs triggered by the event, e.g. push, pull_request.

status.description: Returns workflow runs with the check run status or conclusion.

per_page.description: The number of results per page (max 100). Default: 30

page.description: The page number of the results to fetch. Default: 1

listWorkflowRuns.outputDescription: {total_count, workflow_runs: [...]} where each run is a GitHub workflow run object: id, name, run_number, event, status, conclusion, head_branch, head_sha, created_at, updated_at, run_started_at, html_url, jobs_url, logs_url, actor, head_commit, repository, and more.

listJobsForRun.description: List jobs for a workflow run (GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/runs/{run_id}/jobs). Paginated with per_page and page.

owner.description: The account owner of the repository. The name is not case sensitive.

repo.description: The name of the repository without the .git extension. The name is not case sensitive.

run_id.description: The unique identifier of the workflow run.

filter.description: Filters jobs by their completed_at timestamp. latest returns jobs from the most recent execution of the workflow run. all returns all jobs for a workflow run, including from old executions of the workflow run. Default: latest

per_page.description: The number of results per page (max 100). Default: 30

page.description: The page number of the results to fetch. Default: 1

listJobsForRun.outputDescription: {total_count, jobs: [...]} where each job has id, run_id, name, status, conclusion, started_at, completed_at, steps [{name, status, conclusion, number}], labels, runner_name, html_url, and more.

getJobLogs.description: Get the plain-text log of a workflow job (GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/jobs/{job_id}/logs), returning only the last tail_lines lines.

owner.description: The account owner of the repository. The name is not case sensitive.

repo.description: The name of the repository without the .git extension. The name is not case sensitive.

job_id.description: The unique identifier of the job.

tail_lines.description: Number of lines to return from the end of the log. Default: 500

getJobLogs.outputDescription: {job_id, total_lines, returned_lines, content} where content is the last returned_lines lines of the log joined with \n; each line starts with an ISO timestamp.

source.data: real GitHub Actions runs, jobs and logs from 24 public repositories (api.github.com, captured by capture.ts) plus one synthetic regression seeded into 3 of them (seed.ts); see README.md
source.programs: model-written by Claude Opus 5.5 (claude-opus-5-5) from prompt + api.d.ts; variants from a second model to be added
